Flux fleet: 3 clusters, 4 layers, 10 variants
Read 46 objects

Clusters, one stage each, in order: dev-1 (clusters/dev), staging-1 (clusters/staging), prod-1 (clusters/prod)
Reconcile order (dependsOn): infrastructure -> apps, tenants -> image-automation

infrastructure
  base     flux-infrastructure-base  from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/base
  helm     edge-router: chart edge-router 2.4.x from HelmRepository platform-charts
  stage dev
    dev-1       variant flux-infrastructure-dev-1  ->  Target flux-targets/dev-1
                Kustomization flux-system/infrastructure, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/dev
                  label environment=dev
  stage staging
    staging-1   variant flux-infrastructure-staging-1  ->  Target flux-targets/staging-1
                Kustomization flux-system/infrastructure, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/staging
                  label environment=staging
                  HelmRelease/edge-router replace /spec/values/replicaCount = 2
  stage prod
    prod-1      variant flux-infrastructure-prod-1  ->  Target flux-targets/prod-1
                Kustomization flux-system/infrastructure, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/prod
                  label environment=prod
                  GitRepository/fleet-repo replace /spec/ref/branch = production
                  HelmRelease/edge-router replace /spec/values/replicaCount = 3

apps  (after infrastructure)
  base     flux-apps-base  from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/base/apptique
  stage dev
    dev-1       variant flux-apps-dev-1  ->  Target flux-targets/dev-1
                Kustomization flux-system/apps, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/dev
                  adds namespace.yaml
                  namespace apptique-dev
                  label environment=dev
                  image nginx 1.27.3-alpine (written by image automation)
                  Deployment/frontend replace /spec/replicas = 1
                  substitutes cluster_name=dev-1
                  substitutes environment=dev
                  Flux spec.healthChecks[0].namespace = apptique-dev
  stage staging
    staging-1   variant flux-apps-staging-1  ->  Target flux-targets/staging-1
                Kustomization flux-system/apps, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/staging
                  adds namespace.yaml
                  namespace apptique-staging
                  label environment=staging
                  image nginx 1.27.2-alpine
                  Deployment/frontend replace /spec/replicas = 2
                  substitutes cluster_name=staging-1
                  substitutes environment=staging
                  Flux spec.healthChecks[0].namespace = apptique-staging
  stage prod
    prod-1      variant flux-apps-prod-1  ->  Target flux-targets/prod-1
                Kustomization flux-system/apps, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/prod
                  adds namespace.yaml
                  namespace apptique-prod
                  label environment=prod
                  image nginx 1.26.3-alpine
                  Deployment/frontend replace /spec/replicas = 4
                  substitutes cluster_name=prod-1
                  substitutes environment=prod
                  Flux spec.healthChecks[0].namespace = apptique-prod
  in flight  nginx: 1.27.3-alpine on dev-1; 1.27.2-alpine on staging-1; 1.26.3-alpine on prod-1

  base     flux-image-automation-base  from gitops/flux/expert-fleet/image-automation
  stage dev
    dev-1       variant flux-image-automation-dev-1  ->  Target flux-targets/dev-1

                  adds imagerepository.yaml
                  adds imagepolicy.yaml
                  adds imageupdateautomation.yaml
  note     one cluster uses this layer, so its whole directory is the base

Sources
  - HelmRepository platform-charts  oci://ghcr.io/confighub/charts  (gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/base/sources/charts.yaml)
  - GitRepository fleet-repo  https://github.com/confighub/examples  (gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/base/sources/fleet-repo.yaml)
      branch: dev-1 main, staging-1 main, prod-1 production
  - GitRepository team-checkout  https://github.com/confighub/examples  (gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/base/team-checkout/sync.yaml)
      branch: dev-1 main, staging-1 main, prod-1 production

Writes to Git by itself
  - ImageUpdateAutomation apptique-dev commits to branch main, path gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/dev, running on dev-1

Not in Git
  - what the HelmReleases in infrastructure render: the charts are pulled at reconcile time
  - apps: ${cluster_name}, ${environment}, supplied per cluster by postBuild

Tenants (stay as they are)
  - team-checkout/team-checkout runs as ServiceAccount team-checkout, reading GitRepository team-checkout; governed as part of tenants

Bootstrap (stays outside ConfigHub)
  - gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev/flux-system
  - gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/prod/flux-system
  - gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/staging/flux-system

Handover (apply will write it as handover.sh; plan runs nothing)
  1. keep each layer's Flux Kustomization under its own name and switch its sourceRef to an OCIRepository on the ConfigHub gateway, so Flux keeps its inventory and nothing is reinstalled
  2. first prove each variant renders exactly what Git renders today: infrastructure, apps, tenants, image-automation prune, so anything the release lacks is deleted
  3. suspend ImageUpdateAutomation apptique-dev: it would commit to Git that no longer deploys; its tag should become a proposed ConfigHub change on that variant
  4. GitRepository fleet-repo promotes by branch (dev-1 main, staging-1 main, prod-1 production); after handover the ChangeWorkflow's stages decide, not the branch
  5. GitRepository team-checkout promotes by branch (dev-1 main, staging-1 main, prod-1 production); after handover the ChangeWorkflow's stages decide, not the branch
  6. leave flux-system alone: flux bootstrap owns it, like the Sveltos management record
